title: A Matter of TASTE: Improving Coverage and Difficulty of Agent Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2605.28556v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As agent capabilities advance, existing benchmarks, such as $\tau^2$-Bench, are becoming increasingly saturated. Yet constructing new benchmark tasks remains complex, costly, and labor-intensive. Moreover, the standard approach, in which scenarios are first written in natural language and then mapped to tool sequences, captures only a narrow subset of the tool-use patterns agents exercise. In this paper, we address these problems by reversing the task construction process. We propose TASTE: Task Synthesis from Tool Sequence Evolution, an automatic method that generates challenging tasks with broader tool-use coverage. TASTE utilizes an Adaptive Contrastive $n$-gram model trained on LLM-judged validity signals. This enables sampling valid tool sequences that cover a vast range of tool combinations. translated_title: TASTE 之要义：提升智能体基准测试的覆盖度与难度
translated_abstract: 随着智能体能力的不断进步，诸如 $\tau^2$-Bench 等现有基准测试正日益饱和。然而，构建新的基准测试任务依然复杂、昂贵且耗费人力。此外，标准方法——先以自然语言编写场景，再将其映射为工具序列——仅能覆盖智能体所运用的工具使用模式中的一小部分。在本文中，我们通过颠倒任务构建流程来解决这些问题。我们提出了 TASTE：基于工具序列演化的任务合成（Task Synthesis from Tool Sequence Evolution），这是一种自动生成具有更广泛工具使用覆盖范围且更具挑战性任务的方法。TASTE 利用一种在 LLM 判定的有效性信号上训练的自适应对比 n-gram 模型，从而能够采样出覆盖大量工具组合的有效工具序列。随后，TASTE 通过聚类从序列池中选取代表性序列，将其实例化为完整的基准测试任务，并对……进行精炼。
tldr: 本文提出 TASTE 方法，通过颠倒传统任务构建流程，利用在 LLM 判定有效性信号上训练的自适应对比 n-gram 模型采样覆盖广泛工具组合的有效工具序列，再经聚类选取代表性序列并实例化，从而自动合成覆盖度更广、难度更高的智能体基准测试任务。
en_tdlr: TASTE reverses the conventional benchmark task construction process by evolving tool sequences first—using an adaptive contrastive n-gram model trained on LLM-judged validity signals to sample valid sequences covering diverse tool combinations—and automatically synthesizes challenging agent benchmarks with broader tool-use coverage.
